sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate faithfully encodes the declared plating target, quantity paths, units and datatypes, exact 2 mm normal alternative, strictly lower approved-maintained-coating alternative, and the DIRECT_CALCULATION f2 formula with the required piecewise IF-based tolerance scaled from the expected result. The prior ABS repair instruction is correctly preserved and implemented.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: The DIRECT_CALCULATION query uses ABS(?fnum - ?expected) and ABS(?expected), but ABS is not an allowed registered operation for this verification mode. Replace both absolute-value uses with simple IF-based piecewise expressions (or another permitted +, -, *, /, min/max construction), preserving the required tolerance max(1e-6*ABS(expected),1e-12) scaled from the expected result.

The candidate faithfully encodes the declared plating target, quantity paths, units and datatypes, exact 2 mm normal alternative, strictly lower approved-maintained-coating alternative, and the DIRECT_CALCULATION f2 formula with the required piecewise IF-based tolerance scaled from the expected result. The prior ABS repair instruction is correctly preserved and implemented.
